title: Context Inheritance: Replication Package for the AgenticDev 2026 Study
description:
Replication package for the paper Context Inheritance: A Git-Native Architecture and Pre-Registered Study of Repository Context for AI Coding Agents, accepted as a full paper at the AgenticDev 2026 Workshop (International Workshop on Agentic AI for Next-Generation Software Development), Munich, 12 October 2026.

The study asks when an AI coding agent benefits from repository-carried operating context, in a pre-registered experiment on SWE-bench Verified. The protocol was frozen and tagged as prereg-v1 (commit 056156679a896f0697198bb240c92110aa2df048, 2026-07-09) before any confirmatory run.

This archive contains: the frozen pre-registration and its deviations log; the experiment harness; the blind seed-authoring audit and the camera-ready blind-seed leakage audit; every episode's predictions and promotion decisions; the containerized SWE-bench evaluation verdicts; and the analysis, verification and figure-generation code. Every empirical value reported in the paper is recomputed from these artifacts by experiment/analysis/reproduce_paper.py and experiment/paper/camera-ready-agenticdev2026/analysis/verify_claims.py, both of which run offline with no model or API access.

See experiment/ARTIFACT.md for the reproduction runbook and experiment/DEVIATIONS.md for the record of what was pre-registered, pre-planned, exploratory, or post hoc.
